इद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, kindled, lighted, alight; shin-
ing, glowing, blazing; clean, clear, bright; wonder-
ful; obeyed, unresisted ?; (अम्), n. sunshine, light,
heat; a wonder.
—इद्ध-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, having
the anger excited or kindled.
—इद्धाग्नि (˚ध-
अग्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. one whose fire burns.
